title: nickjhathaway/elucidatornf pipeline parameters
description: A collection of workflows to stream together tools from within elucidator

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pw_ncpus.description: Per region number CPUs to use

pw_pop_clustering_ncpus.description: the number of CPUs during population clustering to use

pw_seqs_table.description: A table of seqs with at least 3 columns, target, name, seq

pw_seqs_table_seqs_col.description: the column name of the seqs column in pw_seqs_table

pw_seqs_table_name_col.description: the column name of the name column in pw_seqs_table

pw_seqs_table_target_col.description: the column name of the target column in pw_seqs_table

pw_gene_ids.description: a no header file with each line being a gene ID

pw_samples_file.description: a no header file with each line being a sample name

pw_bed_fnp.description: a 6 column bed file of regions to run PathWeaver on

bams_dir.description: a directory of coordinate sorted bam files

bams_file_ending.description: the ending of the bam files in bams_dir

render_pw_report.description: whether or not to run quarto on the dashboard quarto docs

run_sub_segments_determination.description: whether to run the sub segment variant determination

sub_segments_correction_occurence_cut_of.description: the correction occurrence cut off to use when doing run_sub_segments_determination

sub_segments_low_freq_cut_off.description: the low frequent cut off to use when doing run_sub_segments_determination

nanopore_clustering_min_len.description: the minimum length for the nanopore clustering pipeline

nanopore_clustering_min_sample_read_coun.description: the minimum amount of reads per sample in order to used in final output

nanopore_primers_errors_allowed.description: the errors to allow in the determination of default parameters when extracting from genomes

nanopore_clustering_ncpus.description: the cpus to use be clustering step

variant_calling_ncpus.description: the number of cpus to use during variant calling

do_variant_calling.description: whether or not to do variant calling

vc_variant_frequency_cut_off.description: the frequency (from 0 to 1) to consider a variant

vc_variant_occurrence_cut_off.description: the absolute count cut off to consider a variant

vc_no_pairwise_comps.description: whether or not to not do pairwise comps when doing variant calling

vc_primary_genome.description: when doing variant calling, the genome to call against

known_amino_acid_changes_fnp.description: a file of known amino acid changes

vc_extra_args.description: extra arguments to give to variant calling

max_time.description: the max amount of time to use per a job

max_retry.description: the max number of retries per job

max_cpus.description: the maximum number of cpus per job

input_fastq_dir.description: a directory of fastq files for amplicon clustering

genome_dir.description: A directory of genome fasta files

gff_dir.description: A directory of annotation gff files

empty_file_fnp.description: An empty file to be used as a default for file options

genome_fnp.description: A fasta file of a genome

meta_fnp.description: Sample meta data, 1 column should be named sample, the rest are meta data

meta_fields_to_calc_pop_diffs.description: When supplying meta data, use these field when doing population differentiation calculations

machine_cpus.description: the cpus currently available on the machine

machine_memory.description: the memory currently available on the machine

max_task_cpus.description: the max CPUs to allow for a task

max_task_memory.description: the max memory to allow for a task

max_task_time.description: the maximum amount of time to allow a single task to run

max_executor_cpus.description: the maximum number of CPUs to use during running the whole pipeline

max_executor_memory.description: the maximum amount of memory to allow the pipeline to use

vc_correct_small_homopolymer_errors.description: if set, will turn on homopolymer gap correction during variant calling on microhaplotypes

nanopore_rename_key_fnp.description: a file for renaming the input samples

nanopore_render_clustering_report.description: quarto render the dashboard for nanopore

amplicon_clustering_pop_clustering_extra.description: the arguments to give the amplicon population clustering for both nanopore/illumina

amplicon_clustering_test_number.description: the amount of testing for detecting extractor parameters determination

amplicon_clustering_number_of_files_to_i.description: the number of files to use for auto determining extractor flags

wgs_samples_keep_file.description: a file where each line is a sample name for processing, only process these samples

wgs_rename_tsv.description: a two column file for renaming wgs file

illumina_clustering_paired_end_length.description: the length of the paired in for the files

illumina_clustering_error_profile.description: the profile to use for clsutering

illumina_clustering_min_sample_read_coun.description: the minimum number of reads to cluster a sample

illumina_clustering_population_ncpus.description: the number of cpus to use during clustering

illumina_clustering_trim_front.description: the trimming of the front after removing primers (a base with a common source of artifact)

illumina_clustering_trim_back.description: the trimming of the back after removing primers (a base with a common source of artifact)

nanopore_clustering_trim_front.description: the trimming of the front after removing primers (a base with a common source of artifact)

nanopore_clustering_trim_back.description: the trimming of the back after removing primers (a base with a common source of artifact)

nanopore_clustering_max_reads_use.description: maximum number of reads to use during clustering

nanopore_extractor_use_inner_primers.description: during nanopore clustering, use the inner primers instead of the default primers

nanopore_clustering_lower_base.description: what to do with lower bases (which is what is done to primers)

nanopore_extractor_primer_within_start.description: how much inwards into the target to search for the primers

pw_extract_region_assemblies_extra_args.description: extract arguments to give to the PathWeaver extracting of a region

pw_pop_clustering_extra_args.description: extra arguments to give tot he pop clustering during PathWeaver

pw_overwrite_dir.description: by default PathWeaver just fills in the directory if it already exists including cached PathWeaver runs

sub_segments_uniqueHapCountCutOff.description: during sub segments creation, filter off clusters with only this amount of  reads

sub_segments_extra_args.description: extra arguments to give sub segment analysis

rnaseq_host1_filter_genome_fasta_fnp.description: the filename path to the first filter genome file

rnaseq_host1_filter_contigs_fnp.description: the filename path to contigs to remove for the first filter

rnaseq_host2_filter_genome_fasta_fnp.description: the filename path to the second filter genome file

rnaseq_host2_filter_contigs_fnp.description: the filename path to contigs to remove for the second filter

single_cell_seurat_r_object_fnp.description: the single cell object Rds file which defines the cell deconvolution

wgs_host1_filter_genome_fasta_fnp.description: the filename path to the first filter genome file

wgs_host1_filter_contigs_fnp.description: the filename path to contigs to remove for the first filter

wgs_host2_filter_genome_fasta_fnp.description: the filename path to the second filter genome file

wgs_host2_filter_contigs_fnp.description: the filename path to contigs to remove for the second filter
